## Setup
```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(effects)
library(cowplot)
library(boot)
```

## Data Wrangling
```{r data}
data_e1 <- read_csv("Experiment1_data.csv") %>%
  mutate(chose_song1 = (song1 == answer))
```

## Demographics - Gender
```{r demographics_gender}
data_gender <- data_e1 %>%
  count(gender)

data_gender
```

## Descriptive Stats - Age Range
```{r demographics_age}
age_range <- data_e1 %>%
  summarise(min_age = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_age = max(age, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n())

age_range
```


## GLM
```{r glm}
mod <- glm(chose_song1 ~ condition, family = binomial, data_e1)
summary(mod)

allEffects(mod)
```

## Binomial Tests
```{r binomial_tests}
person_data <- data_e1 %>%
  filter(condition == "Person") %>%
  summarise(x = sum(chose_song1), n = n())
person_binom <- binom.test(x = person_data$x, n = person_data$n, alternative = "greater")
person_binom
cat("Person 95% CI: [", round(person_binom$conf.int[1], 2), ",", round(person_binom$conf.int[2], 2), "]\n")

ai_data <- data_e1 %>%
  filter(condition == "AI") %>%
  summarise(x = sum(chose_song1), n = n())
ai_binom <- binom.test(x = ai_data$x, n = ai_data$n, alternative = "less")
ai_binom
cat("AI 95% CI: [", round(ai_binom$conf.int[1], 2), ",", round(ai_binom$conf.int[2], 2), "]\n")
```

## Plot
```{r plot}
# Bootstrapped 95% CI
set.seed(42)
boot_mean <- function(x, i) mean(x[i])

plot_data <- map_dfr(unique(data_e1$condition), function(cond) {
  x <- data_e1$chose_song1[data_e1$condition == cond]
  b  <- boot(x, boot_mean, R = 1000)
  ci <- boot.ci(b, type = "perc")$percent[4:5]
  tibble(condition = cond,
         percent  = mean(x) * 100,
         ci_lower = ci[1]  * 100,
         ci_upper = ci[2]  * 100,
         n        = length(x))
})

plot_data$condition <- factor(plot_data$condition, levels = c("Person", "AI"))
plot_data  # print for reporting

ggplot(plot_data, aes(fill = condition, x = condition, y = percent)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  labs(title = "Adult Predictions of Song Played",
       x = "",
       y = "Percent Consistent w/ Separate Minds",
       fill = "Condition") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#999999", "#3D2785")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limit = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100), labels = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, color = "#595959", family = "Avenir Heavy"),
        text = element_text(size = 16, color = "#595959", family = "Avenir Medium"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16, color = "#595959", family = "Avenir Medium"),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#595959"),
        axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#595959"),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color = "#595959"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.justification = "left",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave("exp1.png", bg = "white", width = 7, height = 7)
```
